name: onegate
description: Debug OneGate DApps locally and prepare, validate, and submit public DApp catalog listing requests.

interface.longDescription: Open a DApp at its original URL with a document-start OneGate-compatible NEP-21 Browser Mock, reuse a persistent development account for real signatures, and inspect browser state, console output, screenshots, and dAPI traces. OneGate can also gather public project metadata, validate it against the official catalog form, prepare the exact listing request, and submit it to the public OneGateApp issue tracker only after user review and confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Open my DApp with the OneGate Browser Mock and inspect its dAPI calls.
Review this project and prepare a OneGate DApp listing request.
Submit my DApp to the OneGate catalog after showing me the public request.
